It provides instant access to clean, rhythm, and lead tones inspired by American tube amplifiers. The Trimode features three modes: True Bypass Clean Mode, Rhythm Mode with adjustable drive, and Solo Mode with a mid boost. The pedal's design combines the warmth of a 12AX7 tube with a dual-stage drive, delivering the dynamics of a vintage tube amp, similar to the Marshall BluesBreaker .
